detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🌊 SeaColony

SeaColony is a survival colony-builder set on the open sea. Build and expand a floating settlement, manage your colonists, develop production systems, and survive the challenges of life far from land.

Start with limited space and resources, then gradually turn your small platform into a self-sustaining colony. Every expansion matters as you balance food, water, power, production, storage, and the needs of your colonists.

Research new technologies, establish farms and fishing systems, trade with passing merchant ships, and prepare your colony for pirate raids, fires, harsh weather, and other unexpected events.

⚓ Key Features

🏗️ Build & Expand Your Colony

Expand your floating platform and design a colony that can support a growing population. Plan where you place housing, production buildings, storage, farms, and essential infrastructure.

👥 Manage Your Colonists

Assign work priorities and manage the daily needs of your colonists. Keep them fed, hydrated, rested, and productive as your settlement grows.

⚙️ Production & Resources

Gather resources and build production systems to create food, water, materials, medicine, and other supplies your colony needs to survive.

🌾 Farming & Fishing

Grow crops and harvest food from the sea. Combine farming, fishing, and other food sources to maintain a reliable supply for your colony.

🔬 Research & Technology

Unlock new buildings, equipment, production methods, and power systems through research as your colony develops.

⚡ Power Your Colony

Generate and manage electricity using different power sources. Build batteries and balance energy production and consumption as your infrastructure expands.

💰 Trade with Merchant Ships

Trade surplus resources with passing merchant ships and obtain materials that may be difficult to produce on your own.

🌧️ Survive the Open Sea

Face changing weather, fires, pirate raids, resource shortages, and other events that can threaten the stability of your colony.

📦 Build a Self-Sustaining Settlement

Balance resource production, storage, consumption, and expansion. Every new colonist and every new structure puts additional pressure on your colony's systems.
